brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
The United States seeks Mexico's review of an alleged denial of workers' rights at Yokohama Tire Manufacturing Mexico. [5]

KEY RISKS
Mexico's link to 1,172 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations indicates a risk of further financial or trade restrictions. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Polymarket market on a US strike on Mexico by December 31 is priced Yes at 9% as of Sep 28, 2026, closing Jan 1, 2027. [E6]

WATCH ITEMS
The path and potential landfall of Hurricane Polo, a strong Category 3 storm off Mexico, remains unresolved. [1]
The outcome of the United States' request for Mexico's review of the alleged workers' rights denial at Yokohama Tire Manufacturing Mexico is pending. [5]
